id.description: Unique, stable identifier used for user dismissal tracking. Never reuse an id.

severity.description: Severity level. Higher severity takes precedence.

title.description: Brief headline for the announcement bar.

body.description: Main announcement message. Plain text with **bold** formatting and bare https:// links.

link.description: Optional primary CTA link. Must be an https:// URL without credentials.

linkLabel.description: Optional label for the primary CTA button.

expiresAt.description: Optional ISO 8601 expiration timestamp after which the announcement is retired.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the announcements list was last updated.
